flagged_claims.claim_text: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for FY2016 is $15,037 million
flagged_claims.reason: Implausible gross margin. Microsoft FY2016 revenue was approximately $85 billion. A COGS of $15 billion implies a gross margin over 82%, whereas Microsoft's historical gross margin during this period was typically around 60-65%. The actual Cost of Revenue was approximately $32.8 billion.

Inconsistent trend. The claimed drop from FY2014 ($28.5B) to FY2015 ($19.6B) contradicts Microsoft's financial history where Cost of Revenue remained stable or increased slightly due to cloud infrastructure investments, despite revenue growth.

Part of an implausible downward trend. While closer to historical totals than FY2016 claim, the sequential decline across three years contradicts the company's scale and cost structure during this period.
